# Figma

> > Figma is a collaborative design platform offering AI-powered tools like Figma Make, Figma Sites, and Dev Mode for design, prototyping, and no-code application development.

Figma provides a comprehensive suite of design and development tools including Figma Design for interface creation, FigJam for collaborative whiteboarding, Dev Mode for design-to-code workflows, and AI-powered features like Figma Make for no-code app building. The platform serves teams at companies like SAP, King (Candy Crush), and Doctor Anywhere.

## Key Topics

- Figma Make - AI-powered no-code app builder
- Figma Sites - Website creation and publishing
- FigJam - Collaborative whiteboarding tool
- Dev Mode - Design-to-code developer workflows
- Design systems - Component libraries and collaboration
- Natural language prompts - AI-driven design generation
- Design-to-code - Automated code generation
- Product development - PRD and spec creation
- Dashboard generators - AI-powered data visualization
- No-code development - Build apps without coding
- Design collaboration - Real-time team workflows
- Prototyping - Interactive design testing
- AI website builders - Automated site creation
- Customer stories - Enterprise case studies

## AI-Powered Tools & Features

- [Figma AI: Your Creativity, unblocked with Figma AI](https://www.figma.com/ai): Main landing page for Figma AI tools including Make, Sites, and Code Layers
- [AI PRD Generator: Write Better Product Requirements with AI](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-prd-generator): AI-powered product requirements document generator in Figma Make
- [AI Feature Spec Generator](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-feature-spec-generator): Generate structured feature specs with AI using Figma Make prompts
- [AI Sales Dashboard Generator](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-sales-dashboard-generator): AI-powered sales dashboard builder using Figma Make with natural language
- [AI Fleet Management Dashboard Generator](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-fleet-management-dashboard-generator): Real-time fleet dashboard generator with AI prompts in Figma Make

## No-Code App & Website Builders

- [AI Project Management App Builder](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-project-management-app-builder): Build interactive project management apps without code using Figma Make
- [AI Contact Manager App Builder](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-crm-app-builder): No-code CRM and contact manager app builder using Figma Make AI
- [Small Business Website Builder: AI-powered creation](https://www.figma.com/solutions/small-business-website-builder): No-code AI website builder for small businesses using Figma Make
- [AI Photographer Website Builder](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-photographer-website-builder): Portfolio and booking page builder for photographers using AI prompts
- [Figma Make & Sites Gallery](https://www.figma.com/gallery): Community showcase of live projects built with Figma Make and Sites
